hero.lead: Calcalou puts protein right beside your calories, so you see both at a glance. Scan a barcode or type a meal for free, snap a photo with Premium, and let Lou cheer on your streak.
hero.phone_alt: Calcalou Today screen: 620 kcal left, protein 124 g with the goal reached, and Lou saying the protein goal is reached
hero.lou_alt: Lou, the little character who lives in Calcalou
featured.label: Featured
featured.title: App of the Week
protein.title: Protein, right beside your calories.
protein.sub: Set a daily protein goal and watch it fill up next to your calories, on Today and on your Home Screen.
protein.c1.t: A goal from your body weight
protein.c1.d: Calcalou multiplies your weight by grams per kilogram and shows the maths. Adjust it from 0.8 to 2.0 g/kg or enter your own. Not medical advice.
protein.c2.t: Protein for every food in a photo
protein.c2.d: AI photo scans estimate protein, fat and carbs for each food next to calories. Edit any value before you save; estimates can be wrong.
protein.c3.d: Scan a barcode or type calories and protein yourself, both free. Product data varies, so check the label.
features.title: Log it your way.
features.sub: A photo, a barcode or a few taps. Every entry counts toward your calories, your protein and your streak.
scan.title: Snap your plate. See every food.
scan.text: AI photo recognition turns your meal into an estimate in seconds. Each food gets its own row with grams and calories; open one to check or change its protein, fat and carbs before you add it to your log.
scan.tag: Premium · up to 50 scans a day · 18+
scan.alt: Photo scan of a plate with salmon, rice and broccoli. On your plate: grilled salmon 150 g, 360 kcal; steamed rice 200 g, 260 kcal; broccoli 150 g, 70 kcal; estimated total 690 kcal
barcode.title: Scan a barcode. It's free.
barcode.text: Point the camera at a package, pick a serving and Calcalou fills in calories, protein, fat and carbs. Product data varies, so check the label when it matters.
barcode.alt: Barcode scan of Greek yogurt 2%: one 170 g serving, protein 11.9 g, fat 3.4 g, carbs 8 g, total 111 kcal
streak.title: Log daily. Level up.
streak.text: Every day you log keeps your streak alive, earns XP and unlocks achievements. Lou celebrates with you and gently nudges you when you skip a day.
streak.alt: Achievements: 4 of 20 unlocked at Level 7, 266 XP to Level 8, with Century Streak at 31 of 100 days
more.title: Plays nicely with your phone.
final.title: Your streak starts today.
final.alt: Lou cheering with both paws up
